comment: Registry of knowledge packs. 'kind' selects the indexer: book = distilled chapter md satisfying the chapter contract in FORMAT.md; engine = large vendor docs indexed by byte offset; notes = free-form md (research reports, own conventions) filed by category. Add a pack here, drop its files under path/, then run scripts/build_index.py. To add ad-hoc documents instead, drop them in inbox/ and run scripts/ingest.py.

packs.title: Machine Learning for Trading, 3rd ed.
packs.author: Stefan Jansen
caveats: Chapter 20 is absent from the distilled set (numbering jumps 19 -> 21). Treat any Ch. 20 reference as unindexed.

packs.title: Algorithmic Short Selling with Python, 2nd ed.
packs.author: Laurent Bernut
caveats: ASSP-06 ships DELIBERATE lookahead bias for pedagogy (signal alignment + P&L computed after resize). Never inherit its P&L ordering without fixing both.
ASSP-05 pairs-trading thresholds are optimized on a single pair and are explicitly not expected to generalize.

packs.title: Research notes & reports
caveats: Derived material: own research output, agent reports, working conventions. Cite it as such and never let it silently override a book rule -- if it contradicts one, surface the disagreement.
Populated by scripts/ingest.py from inbox/. Categories are subdirectories.

packs.title: VectorBT PRO documentation
caveats: Licensed material. Raw files are gitignored by default; see README before committing them to a public remote.
Docs describe the engine's capabilities, not sound method. Method rules come from the book packs.
